dogecoin.text: This is important because the average dogecoin network/TX fee this year has been ~2 DOGE. That worked well when a year ago, DOGE was $0.003, but now at $0.22 the DOGE devs decided it was time for an update (this process started back in August).

To speak of DOGE network/TX fees, a few weeks ago the @dogecoin_devs issued a release to finalize “a new minimum fee recommendation for all participants on the Dogecoin network” 

https://t.co/eb4QA6tU7r

In my last thread highlighting our first $DOGE test transaction, many noted the substantial decrease in the DOGE network fee. 

I thought a refresher on network fees was in order + a shout out to @dogecoin_devs for the recent fee reduction update @JRossNicoll @michilumin

👇
